title: Candidate dcp-jcs-v2, phase 2: expected routes where a historical adapter is consulted
status: Experimental and non-normative. dcp-jcs-v1 remains the only canonicalization profile.

how_to_read.cases: The units of the corpus whose `historical` parameter only simulates a parser, and synthetic units with NaN, 1e999 and a lone surrogate. All are bare units.
how_to_read.decoder_reading: What the real decoder returns at bundle.manifest.canonicalization_profile: absent, dcp-jcs-v1, dcp-jcs-v2, other, or fails. Measured by running the decoder, not simulated.
how_to_read.expected: The route outcome under the policy of the case, by §6.4: offsets are relative to the unit (equal to the input offset for bare). adapter_calls is how many times the adapter is consulted.
how_to_read.corpus_historical_parameter: The simulated value in corpus.json, kept only for comparison; it is not evidence.
